subject: Readiness: staffing, docs blockers, and canary plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2025-10-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Readiness: staffing, docs blockers, and canary plan

Team —

We're two weeks out from the release window and I want to surface a compact list of open items that need owners and answers this week so we don't block launch cadence. High level asks:

- Confirm doc owners for the external runbook, enablement training, and post-launch ops playbook.
- Identify any staffing gaps for the canary (host list + backup oncall).
- Call out any deliverables that won't make the current canary and whether we should shift the canary window.

Quick context: the initial canary will be a single-region ramp to 50 qps with manual rollback. The runbook draft is attached (canary_runbook_v1.pdf) and the working doc is here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b-canary-runbook

Please reply with owners and a short yes/no for the canary date by EOD Friday (10/10). If any of you have hard blockers, flag them inline.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Product Manager, Launch Readiness
Redwood Inference

Attachments: canary_runbook_v1.pdf (attachment)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-10-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Readiness: staffing, docs blockers, and canary plan

Thanks Marissa — quick updates inline.

> - Confirm doc owners for the external runbook, enablement training, and post-launch ops playbook.

- External runbook: owner = Kimberly Park (I'll own sign-off + external review).
- Enablement training deck: owner = Aditya Rao (will coordinate with Sales Eng).
- Post-launch ops playbook: owner = Tessa Morgan (ops escalation flows).

Open items I see:
- The incident playbook section for KV-cache eviction is incomplete; engineering needs to add two pages (SUP-4382).
- Need a short troubleshooting cheat sheet for customer success — I can draft but need engineering proof.

I've attached the provisional enablement slots spreadsheet with proposed dates and CS leads (enablement_slots.xlsx).


Kimberly Park
Director, Developer Relations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: enablement_slots.xlsx (attachment)

Date: 2025-10-06T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Readiness: staffing, docs blockers, and canary plan

Agree with Kimberly's owners. A couple of infra constraints to call out from my side:

- We're still stabilizing the KV cache compaction optimization; engineering lead says it will be in a release candidate on 10/08 but not fully validated under sustained traffic. That maps to SUP-4382.
- Given that risk, I recommend we shift the canary start by 48 hours to allow a final validation pass and one smoke run with synthetic traffic. If leadership wants to keep the original date, we should reduce canary target from 50 qps to 30 qps and add an immediate rollback trigger (5 minute avg latency spike).

Link to the runbook PR with infra notes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runbooks/pull/72

Aditya Rao
Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Date: 2025-10-07T10:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Readiness: staffing, docs blockers, and canary plan

Marissa —

This needs leadership visibility. If we're asking for a 48-hour shift to validate infra, we should get VP Product and VP Eng aligned this week. A last-minute change has downstream impacts on sales demos next week and some scheduled CS enablement sessions.

Proposed next step: 30-minute exec sync with VP Product (Julie), VP Eng (Rohan Mehta), and myself + Marissa + Aditya to confirm whether to shift the canary or reduce the scope. If Julie (external) needs to be in the loop, I can forward a short brief.

Tessa Morgan
Head of Customer Ops
Redwood Inference

Date: 2025-10-08T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Readiness: staffing, docs blockers, and canary plan

Thanks all — I agree we should elevate this now and get a short decision window. I've drafted a 30-minute agenda and proposed two options for leadership: shift canary + full validation (preferred) or keep date with reduced qps and stronger rollback triggers.

Proposed exec sync: 2025-10-09 15:00 PT (30 min)
Agenda:
- Quick state from engineering (Aditya) — validation status and risks
- Runbook readiness and CS enablement impact (Kimberly)
- Ops readiness and rollback criteria (Tessa)
- Decision and next steps (VP Product / VP Eng)

I've attached a short playbook summary (canary_playbook_v1.md) and will push a one-pager to the drive before the sync.

If that time doesn't work for Julie from Acme, please let me know and we'll propose an alternate.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Product Manager, Launch Readiness
Redwood Inference

Attachments: canary_playbook_v1.md (attachment)

Confirming 10/09 15:00 PT works for me and I've invited CS leads from Acme (Julie) to the brief so they can confirm training impact. Small ask for the sync: please have the enablement_slots.xlsx handy (I attached earlier) and be prepared to commit to one training slot if leadership chooses to keep the canary date.

Also, Marissa — if we shift the canary, we need to update the customer-facing demo calendar and notify three active prospects; I can draft the emails if you approve.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Developer Relations
Redwood Inference
